name: Neon Line
description: Characters drawn as single continuous glowing neon lines on a deep night-blue wall: one pink, one cyan, with a soft bloom, a flicker when they switch on, neon-script captions, and small glowing props (phones, clocks, a skyline) in the same line style.
best_use_cases: Stories where two sides come together for the ending
style: Glowing neon line characters on a deep night-blue wall
